description: Ideal magnetite from lammps_post.references: nearest Fe-O distances by direct image enumeration and the first two non-empty bins of compute_reference_rdf, against analytic Fd-3m (origin 2) bond lengths.
source: Analytic: a = 8.396 A and u = 0.2549 as declared in lammps_post/references.py (CRYSTAL_DB["Fe3O4"]); tetrahedral Fe-O = a*sqrt(3)*(u-1/8), octahedral Fe-O = a*sqrt((1/2-u)^2 + 2(u-1/4)^2); 8 tetrahedral and 16 octahedral Fe per 56-atom cell. Same oracle as tests/test_audit_references_plots.py.

sources.n_fe: crystallography: Fd-3m conventional cell holds 8 formula units, Fe on 8a (8) + 16d (16)
sources.coordination_histogram: crystallography: 8a is tetrahedral (4 O), 16d octahedral (6 O); references.py comment records an ASE space-group-227 cross-check (AUDIT-20261027)
sources.nearest_fe_o_sorted: analytic from a and u: a*sqrt(3)*(u-1/8) and a*sqrt((1/2-u)^2+2(u-1/4)^2)
sources.rdf_first_two_nonzero_r: same two analytic distances, compared with compute_reference_rdf bin centres (tolerance one bin width)
